steps.title: Assemble reaction with kit
steps.instruction: Prepare the qRT‑PCR reaction using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One‑Step qRT‑PCR Kit (Life Technologies, Catalog #11732088).

steps.title: Program thermal cycler
steps.instruction: Set the cycler to the following program: 50 °C for 5 min, then 95 °C for 2 min, then 95 °C for 3 sec, followed by 40 cycles of 60 °C for 30 sec with a fluorescence acquisition step at each cycle.

steps.title: Interpret amplification curves
steps.instruction: Evaluate each reaction’s fluorescence trace: a satisfactory positive shows a sigmoidal curve with an exponential rise, a clear plateau, and a fluorescence intensity above the positive‑control level; the crossing point (C_T) must be reached before the 40‑cycle limit (C_T < 40). No‑template controls (NTCs) must not generate a curve. Use these criteria to call samples positive or negative.
